description: Source-audited PhyloTree mtDNA + YBrowse Y-chromosome haplogroup defining SNP trees for haplogroup assignment via tree-walk algorithm. SNPs filtered to 23andMe v5-era array coverage. Resolution varies with the markers typed by each array revision.

audit.scope: Incremental-to-complete PhyloTree Build 17 audit for issue 1798. 165 marker-exact nodes retain emitted-marker and coverage locks; independent raw-row comparison classifies 160 direct motifs as exact and 5 legacy motifs as partial. All other emitted nodes have explicit pending or structural states. Schema v3 distinguishes general flattened source intermediates from caller-unreportable intermediates and separately accounts for retired emitted identities. Completion requires every direct motif and source-topology edge to become exact.

omitted_nodes.A+152: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 06: Build 17 places the mutation-only A+152 segment between A and A2. Its historical-only T152C! event remains source-only.
omitted_nodes.A+152+16362: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 06: Build 17 places mutation-only A+152+16362 between A+152 and A2. Its primary-callable T16362C event is emitted on A2 with source ownership; helper-only support is 1/5, below the caller threshold.
omitted_nodes.B4+16261: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 10: Build 17 places an unnamed C16261T segment between B4 and B4a. The callable helper remains source-only so it cannot terminal-call B4a without B4a-direct evidence.
omitted_nodes.B4b'd'e'j: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 10: Build 17 places shared B4b'd'e'j ancestry between B4 and B4b. Its events remain source-only so shared ancestry cannot provide B4b terminal credit.
omitted_nodes.CZ: Flattened in issue 1797: Build 17 defines this structural parent of C and Z only by A249d, whose position is unrepresented in all four modern export exemplars and whose deletion allele is unsupported by the substitution-only caller. C and Z remain children of M8 so they inherit the source-backed lineage without an unscoreable 0/0 path step.
omitted_nodes.D+16189: Flattened mutation-only Build 17 intermediate between D and D5: its sole back-mutation/reversion T16189C! event is absent or non-callable in all five pinned 23andMe exports. D5 remains a direct child of emitted D, not D4.
omitted_nodes.D4b1: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 04: Build 17 places D4b1 between D4b and D3. All four events remain source-only because D3's four direct markers are sufficient and copying shared ancestry evidence would weaken specificity.
omitted_nodes.D4b1c: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 04: Build 17 places D4b1c immediately above D3. All three events remain source-only: D3's four direct markers are sufficient, and a D4b1c lineage that lacks the D3 row must stop at the honest emitted ancestor D4b.
omitted_nodes.D4e: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 04: Build 17 places D4e between D4 and D2. Its callable m.11215 event remains source-only so broad D4e-prefix evidence cannot manufacture a D2 call.
omitted_nodes.D4e1: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 04: Build 17 places D4e1 immediately above D2. Both events remain source-only to preserve issue 1907's literal two-marker D2 contract and prevent source-prefix over-resolution.
omitted_nodes.D4e1'3: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 04: Build 17 places D4e1'3 between D4e and D4e1. Its callable m.9536 event remains source-only to bound D2 source-prefix support below the caller threshold.
omitted_nodes.F1+16189: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 10: Build 17 places an unnamed T16189C! segment between F1 and F1b. The event is unavailable in all five pinned exports and remains source-only.
omitted_nodes.F1a'c'f: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 10: Build 17 places shared F1a'c'f ancestry between F1 and F1a. Its events remain source-only so shared ancestry cannot provide F1a terminal credit.
omitted_nodes.G2a'c: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 05: Build 17 places G2a'c between G2 and G2a. Its callable G9575A event is retained on G2a with source ownership; helper-only 1/4 support remains below the 2/4 caller threshold.
omitted_nodes.H+195: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 08: Build 17 places an unnamed T195C! segment between H and H11. The event is absent or non-callable in all five pinned exports and remains source-only.
omitted_nodes.H1+16189: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 09: Build 17 places an unnamed T16189C! segment between H1 and H1b. The event is absent or non-callable in all five pinned exports and remains source-only.
omitted_nodes.H5'36: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 08: Build 17 places shared H5'36 between H and H5. Its callable C456T event remains source-only because copying shared ancestry onto markerless H5 would create a false terminal H5 call.
omitted_nodes.HV0a: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 10: Build 17 places HV0a between HV0 and V. Its callable C15904T event remains source-only so HV0a ancestry cannot terminal-call V without V-direct evidence.
omitted_nodes.J1+16193: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 11: Build 17 places a mutation-only C16193T segment between J1 and J1d. The event is non-callable in all five pinned exports and remains source-only.
omitted_nodes.K1c: Pruned from the array-reportable tree in issue 1743: its direct Build-17 motif is limited to recurrent control-region substitutions (m.146/m.152) plus m.498d, while the former emitted m.9716 belongs to K2.

omitted_nodes.Z+152: Flattened in issue 1798 batch 05: the mutation-only Build 17 Z+152 segment lies between Z and Z1. Its T152C! event remains source-only because it is callable only in the historical 2014 exemplar.
